## Distribution Drafts
Turns a new piece into a LinkedIn post and a Reddit discussion post. Drafts land in the Queue tab and your inbox. Nothing is posted automatically.

parameters.formDescription: Paste the URL of the published piece.

values.formSubmittedText: Thanks. A confirmation is on its way to your inbox.
